facts.text: Maria shared a photograph of a group of people standing around a table with food, which she described as a reminder that being kind matters.

evidence.quote: Here's a shot I got when I volunteered. Reminds me being kind matters! [image: a photography of a group of people standing around a table with food]

facts.text: John acknowledged Maria's photograph and stated that small acts of kindness can make a significant difference.

evidence.quote: That's a cool photo, Maria! Small acts like that can really make a difference.

facts.text: Maria expressed agreement with John's sentiment about the importance of community support and stated her intention to continue her efforts.

evidence.quote: Thanks, John! I totally agree, so I'm gonna keep it up.

facts.text: John emphasized the value of having a supportive team and mentioned that the bond he feels now is similar to the one he experienced during his time in the military.

evidence.quote: We have different skills and talents, but they all contribute to serving and protecting our community. And it's a bond I haven't felt since my time in the military.
